intent: Design tokens: color, space, radius, type, shadow, and motion primitives with semantic roles.
Primary action control for forms and dashboards.
Joined row of kit Buttons.
Single KPI tile with title, metric, and optional trend.
Horizontal row of Scorecards for a metrics strip.
Single-line text entry with optional start and end slots inside the field.
One-time code / PIN as separate slots. Paste and autocomplete work. Not a row of Inputs.
A recommended insight or opportunity as a compact card, with tone and optional actions.
Multi-line text for notes. Florence field. Wrap with Field.
Dropdown for choosing one option from a short fixed list.
Immediate on/off setting. Pill track, role=switch. Not a Checkbox.
Multi-select or confirmation control. Optional visible label.
Single show/hide panel.
Searchable command menu for quick actions.
Responsive structured data with search, filters, column settings, and clear empty states.
Form field that opens kit Calendar to pick one date.
Month grid for picking one date.
Inline cell content for datasets: text, avatar, file, payment, badge, trend, avatar group, select, progress, rating, or row actions.
Column header for DataTable: label, optional select-all checkbox, sm or md.
Framed tile with optional header, body, and footer actions.
Choose exactly one option from a small visible radio set.
One labeled control with optional hint and error. Label on top or start (left).
Semantic group of fields with a legend and optional description.
Compact status or category pill.
Path to the current page as a hierarchy of links.
Brief supplementary text on hover or focus.
Switch between related in-page panels.
Dismissible overlay for short tasks, forms, or extra detail. Composes ModalCard. Not a must-choose confirm.
The panel chrome for a modal (title, body, footer). Use inside Modal, or standalone in docs. Not a page Card.
Edge panel for secondary tasks that need more room than a Modal.
Actions or value menu from a button, field, or nav trigger.
Horizontal site nav. Dropdowns are kit DropdownMenu. Not SideNav. Not AppNav.
Top-of-page title block with optional actions.
Page navigation with previous, next, page numbers, and ellipsis. Not ButtonGroup. Not Tabs.
Grouped content block with optional heading.
Vertical sidebar navigation with active item state.
Florence product side nav: brand header, icon items, optional badges, closeable. Not AppNav. Not Drawer.
Simple semantic table for text rows — not a data grid.
One-open disclosure list for short related sections.
Inline status banner that stays on the page.
Must-choose overlay that interrupts until the user cancels or confirms.
Face or initials for a person. Not a status chip and not a button.
Overlapping row of kit Avatars with an optional leftover count.
Dashboard blueprint: PageHeader, Scoreboard, Section, Table, Buttons.
Settings blueprint: PageHeader, Fields, and save actions.
List-detail blueprint: AppNav, Table, and detail Section.
